title: The Plush Pavilion
description: A dialogue between baroque architecture and contemporary Design. Traditional wall moldings establish a classical framework, referencing historical interiors while structuring the space with rhythm and symmetry. Within this architectural envelope, contemporary furniture and lighting introduce lighter, sculptural forms that bring balance and clarity.Across an office space, a bedroom, and a living room, the project explores how atmosphere can shift through materiality and color while maintaining a coherent architectural language.The material palette remains restrained. Natural wood provides warmth and grounding, while upholstered elements soften the composition. Color plays a key role in defining the atmosphere: deep burgundy,muted sage, and saturated blue create distinct spatial identities while maintaining a cohesive visual language.By juxtaposing historical references with modern forms, the project explores how ornament and minimalism can coexist, allowing the past to inform the present without overpowering it
